brief.targetViewer: English-speaking beginner Korean learner who wants one quick sentence practice with a recall check.
brief.whyClickNow: Learn and repeat one Korean school sentence in 30 seconds, then check the missing word while the context is fresh.
brief.viewerPromise: The viewer learns 학교 through the real sentence 학교 앞에서 친구를 만납니다 instead of an isolated vocabulary card.
brief.angle: Use a school-front friend-meeting sentence so the meaning is easy to infer before the blank recall beat.
hookOptions: Which word fits this Korean sentence?
Learn one Korean school sentence with Seolmin
Read it once, then fill the Korean blank
proofPlan: Introduce the full sentence before any blank recall.
Repeat the full sentence once for pronunciation rhythm.
Use the blank sentence in scene-4 as the recall check.
Close with the standard Malmoelab CTA and Seolmin farewell.
brief.packagingRule: Title, thumbnail, and opening frame must promise a short Korean sentence practice without reducing the episode to a standalone 학교 flashcard.
brief.engagementCopy: Double tap if you know it.

scenes.goal: Open with the standard 003 greeting and establish Seolmin as the host.
Introduce the full lesson sentence: 학교 앞에서 친구를 만납니다.
Use the repeat cue and then read the full lesson sentence once.
Switch to the blank sentence: ___ 앞에서 친구를 만납니다.
